what_was_tried: Customer retrain adding (a) real-data hard negatives (same building, unrelated company names; only 114 such pairs exist), (b) realistic name/address variation using the public cleanco legal-form list, (c) the 111 decided assistant-reviewed pairs as real-data evidence (matches x3, distincts x2).
evaluation: Group-wise 2-fold cross-fit on the reviewed pairs: records and company families of the held-out fold never appear in that fold's training data; band-weighted metrics.
decision: Not adopted: F0.5 did not improve, estimated false merges were ~2.4x higher, and the learned blocking (name 3-character-start predicates; every name in this file starts with 'A') exhausted memory on the full-file matching step. Higher recall alone is not an improvement for golden-record safety.
likely_reasons: only ~55 real labelled pairs per fold: too few to move a Dedupe classifier
assistant-reviewed labels are not human ground truth
